The graph of \(g\) has the same vertical asymptote and the same shape, but its corresponding point is at \((1,4)\). Thus \(g\) is \(f\) shifted upward by \(4\) units. Checking another point, \(g(8)\approx 6.08\), which equals \(\ln(8)+4\).
